manifest.name: Focus Mode
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Hides distractions and enables a minimalist, distraction-free writing environment

css: .focus-mode-active .sidebar { display: none !important; } .focus-mode-active .header { display: none !important; } .focus-mode-active .footer { display: none !important; } .focus-mode-active .breadcrumb { display: none !important; } .focus-mode-active .card-detail { max-width: 800px; margin: 60px auto; padding: 40px; } .focus-mode-toggle { position: fixed; top: 10px; right: 10px; z-index: 10000; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .focus-mode-toggle:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); transform: scale(1.05); } .focus-mode-active .focus-mode-toggle { background: rgba(0,123,255,0.8); } body.dark-theme .focus-mode-toggle { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: white; } body.dark-theme .focus-mode-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
